description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Additional Spells: Shield, Lesser Restoration, Protection from Energy, Banishment and Wall of Force are always prepared once you have slots of that level (add them from the compendium). Protective Ward: when you cast an Abjuration spell with a spell slot, the module asks who gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the slot level - you or a creature you can see within 30 ft.

system.requirements: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Protective Ward temp HP offered by the module after a slot Abjuration spell.
